summary: Control Preferences Comprehensive Testing Complete - All features implemented and working. 3 tabs (Shift Planner, Login, Requests) verified. Backend API and Frontend UI fully functional.

backend_api_tests: GET /api/control-preferences returns all settings including login and requests fields
PUT /api/control-preferences saves PIN settings (pin_length, max_failed_attempts, lockout_duration)
PUT /api/control-preferences saves authentication mode (pin_only, qr_only, qr_and_pin)
PUT /api/control-preferences saves late/early clock-in controls (grace minutes, mandatory reasons)
PUT /api/control-preferences saves session controls (timeouts, multiple devices)
PUT /api/control-preferences saves leave controls (notice days, max leave days, day off requests)
PUT /api/control-preferences saves swap controls (direct/open swaps, expiry hours)
PUT /api/control-preferences saves additional controls (grace tolerance, attendance patterns)
Manager role has access to control preferences
frontend_ui_tests: Control Preferences page loads with 3 tabs: Shift Planner, Login, Requests
Shift Planner tab shows staffing requirements, consecutive limits, rest rules, overtime, agency settings
Login tab shows PIN Settings section with PIN length, max failed attempts, lockout duration, PIN change frequency
Login tab shows Authentication Mode with 3 options (PIN Only, QR Code Only, QR Code + PIN)
Login tab shows Late & Early Clock-In Controls with grace periods and toggles
Login tab shows Late/Early Reason Management section
Login tab shows Staff Session Controls with timeout settings
Requests tab shows Leave Request Controls with notice days, max leave days, day off requests per month
Requests tab shows Shift Swap Controls with direct/open swap toggles and expiry hours
Save Changes button saves preferences and shows 'Saved!' success feedback

late_early_controls: Notify manager when staff is late

leave_controls: Max Day Off Requests Per Month

save_functionality.feedback: Shows 'Saved!' with green checkmark after successful save
